title: Inheritance and Will
author: Kestrel Halloran
blurb: Rafael Villalobos, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
